pages:changelog.title: Changelog
pages:changelog.description: A complete release route with shared site navigation, one Marker-led featured release, a captioned version history, and the shared footer.

pages:integrations.title: Integrations
pages:integrations.description: A complete ecosystem route with blue character-led orientation, a flat connector directory, one contextual closing action, and the shared varunUI footer.

pages:about.title: About
pages:about.description: A complete varunUI about route with a blue product premise, pink mission and team, working principles, yellow system facts, one closing action, and the shared site footer without invented company history.

pages:pricing.title: Pricing
pages:pricing.description: A complete buying route with yellow character-led orientation, a three-plan billing choice, a detailed responsive comparison, pink human support, one trial action, and the shared varunUI site footer.

pages:product-home.title: Product Home
pages:product-home.description: The canonical varunUI product site flow: site navigation, one blue character-led promise, system facts, a real component-composed product preview, green customer proof, pink human support, one closing action, and the complete site footer.

pages:categorized-faq.title: Categorized FAQ
pages:categorized-faq.description: Use only when questions form stable, meaningful groups. A category control changes one shared accordion rather than multiplying panels.

pages:help-center.title: Help Centre
pages:help-center.description: The canonical support flow: orient, search, narrow by topic, read the answer, then escalate to a person or system status when needed.

pages:searchable-faq.title: Searchable FAQ
pages:searchable-faq.description: Use when the answer set is long enough that visitors arrive with a specific question. Search narrows a single familiar accordion.

pages:standard-faq.title: Standard FAQ
pages:standard-faq.description: The default FAQ recipe: a clear marker-led introduction and one readable accordion column. Start here unless the content proves it needs more.

pages:waitlist.title: Join the Waitlist
pages:waitlist.description: Full-height waitlist capture with an email field, a join button, a social-proof line, and a sign-in link for existing users.

pages:article-hub.title: Article Hub
pages:article-hub.description: Blog hub with a featured story, alternating feature stack, article-card grid, compact rail, and text archive.

pages:article-with-comments.title: Article with Comments
pages:article-with-comments.description: Article with full comment system, replies, likes, and featured comments.

pages:case-study-with-metrics.title: Case Study with Metrics
pages:case-study-with-metrics.description: A focused case-study page with one thesis, client context, outcome metrics, three evidence sections, and one attributed quote without a generic article prop schema.

pages:diy-how-to-tutorial.title: DIY How-To Tutorial
pages:diy-how-to-tutorial.description: Step-by-step tutorial with tools needed, learning outcomes, and tips per step.

pages:interactive-checklist-article.title: Interactive Checklist Article
pages:interactive-checklist-article.description: Article with checkable items, progress tracking, and print/download options.

pages:interactive-poll-article.title: Interactive Poll Article
pages:interactive-poll-article.description: Article with embedded poll, vote tracking, and results display.

pages:interactive-quiz-article.title: Interactive Quiz Article
pages:interactive-quiz-article.description: Quiz format with multiple choice questions, scoring, and results.

pages:knowledge-base-article.title: Knowledge Base Article
pages:knowledge-base-article.description: Searchable FAQ with category filters, helpful votes, and related questions.

pages:live-blog-updates.title: Live Blog Updates
pages:live-blog-updates.description: Live blog format with timestamped updates, breaking news badges, and auto-refresh.

pages:long-form-article-system.title: Long-Form Article
pages:long-form-article-system.description: Long-form article recipe with sticky section navigation, hero media, author context, topic tags, article actions, related reading, and composed article prose.

pages:multi-part-series-article.title: Multi-Part Series Article
pages:multi-part-series-article.description: Series article with part navigation, progress bar, and previous/next links.

pages:product-comparison-article.title: Product Comparison Article
pages:product-comparison-article.description: Head-to-head comparison with feature matrix, pros/cons, and winner verdict.

pages:readiness-status-dashboard.title: Readiness Dashboard
pages:readiness-status-dashboard.description: Coming soon section with a status dashboard showing service readiness with color-coded indicators for ready, in-progress, and planned states.

pages:technical-article-playbook.title: Technical Article
pages:technical-article-playbook.description: Consolidated recipe for technical posts with named intro, prerequisites, implementation notes, copyable code, workflow steps, and completion sections.

pages:year-and-month-archive.title: Year and Month Archive
pages:year-and-month-archive.description: Blog archive organized by year and month, with compact dated rows that can include image, category, author, and read time.
